# Oxide Launcher 1.5.0

Every screen is now the Oxide GUI. No button in it opens the old presentation any more.

## What the device recording exposed, and what it actually was

**The intro never showed its logo.** Three bugs were stacked, and only the third explains a black
screen: the logo was scaled about the screen's top-left so its centre could never reach the sidebar
slot, an early return deleted it the instant the journey finished, and the curtain was drawn last,
on top of it, holding at full opacity for the first 2.45s. The logo was never visible for a single
frame. All three are fixed, and the resting sidebar logo now takes its size from the intro's own
measurement, so there is no size jump at the hand-off.

**CurseForge worked in debug and failed in release.** `release.yml` passes `CURSEFORGE_API_KEY` from a
GitHub secret that does not exist, and an unconfigured secret expands to an empty string rather than
to nothing - so `System.getenv` returned `""` and short-circuited the whole fallback chain before it
could read the key from `gradle.properties`. Confirmed live: with the header 200, without it 403.
The resolver now treats blank as absent, and a build task fails any release that would ship an empty
key. The same latent bug was fixed for the OAuth client id and the signing passwords.

**Dropdowns opened detached** because `calculatePosition` runs before the popup is measured, so the
panel collapsed onto the control's right edge. Position is now a pure function of a measured anchor
rect, the window, and a panel size derived from the option count, so first-open position is final.

**Page transitions were sliding 18% of the container width** instead of the reference's 18dp - about
ten times too far.

**Deep navigation from the Instances page was a silent no-op.** `viewModel<ScreenBackStackViewModel>()`
inside a NavDisplay entry resolves against that entry's own store, not the activity's, so export and
every content manager did nothing - no crash, no log line.

**Settings controls saved correctly and repainted nothing**, because no composable in the new GUI read
`MaterialTheme`: the palette was about thirty hardcoded near-black values. Tokens are now reactive,
so dark mode and colour theme apply live. Eight toggles were still live on visibly disabled rows, and
contrast tiers measured 2.45:1 at 6-8sp; every tier now clears 4.5:1.

## Replaced, not layered

Account, multiplayer, files, logs, the launch/start presentation, the five per-instance content
managers, per-instance settings, the Minecraft version install flow, the modpack export wizard and
the modify-instance wizard are all Oxide screens on the existing backend. Deep navigation that
previously came from a launch pre-flight prompt now goes through the event stream instead of leaking
navigation state into the activity. No old screen was deleted - the legacy version manager still
references them - but the new GUI never reaches them.

## Also

A real interface scale setting, applied at exactly two points, with the column count falling out of
the existing maths so cards narrow instead of clipping. The supplied launcher icon across all five
densities, sitting inside the adaptive safe zone at 57% of the canvas, with a monochrome layer.

Three bugs found by the tests that would have shipped: `TextUnit.Unspecified` cannot take part in
arithmetic and `letterSpacing` defaults to it, so reading any type-ramp style would have crashed the
launcher; the sidebar's active-rail track was laid out at full height, pushing the footer off-screen
at 640x340; and a file-level `mutableStateOf` in the theme ran `Resources.getSystem()` at class-load
time, which made the functions that file documents as pure untestable.

521 unit tests. Verified by CI only - compilation, tests, lint, R8, packaging, signing. Not validated
on physical hardware.
